title: Hugging Face releases ThinkingBox-Training for agent post-training
excerpt: The new tool uses database state outcomes as rewards to improve AI agent performance.
bodyHtml:
Hugging Face announced on October 22, 2026, the availability of ThinkingBox-Training on GitHub. The framework evaluates AI agent performance by comparing final database states against expected outcomes, using these results as reward signals for post-training.

According to Hugging Face, the method was applied to the Qwen3.8-27B model using 50 steps of GRPO. Following the training, the model's average success rate on benchmark tasks rose from 51.70% to 60.78%. Additionally, the number of tasks completed correctly on all twenty attempts increased from 38 to 107.

The training pool for the model consisted of tasks selected based on offline policy-relative difficulty, which estimates a task's success probability using a base policy. The final checkpoint was evaluated on the 507-task ThinkingBox-Bench, which the model had not encountered during its training phase. Each of its 507 tasks in ThinkingBox-Bench hands an agent a real backend and a set of tools, lets it work, then checks what really changed in the database.
topic: Turning Database Grading into RL Rewards: Post-Training Agents with ThinkingBox
